form.violation.already_authorized: This visit has already been approved, so it cannot be approved again. What is shown now is the current record.
form.violation.appointment_not_cancellab: This appointment is already closed, so there is nothing left to cancel. What is shown now is the current record.
form.violation.appointment_not_confirmed: This appointment is not confirmed, so the vehicle cannot be received against it. Confirm the time first, then receive the vehicle.

form.violation.appointment_not_reschedul: This appointment is already closed — the vehicle was received, or the appointment was cancelled or missed — so its time cannot be changed. Book a new appointment instead.
form.violation.appointment_time_unreadab: The date and time entered here could not be read. Enter the date and the time again.
form.violation.appointment_time_zone_mis: The date and time entered here does not say which time zone it belongs to, and we will not guess: booking an hour in the wrong zone means the customer arrives on the wrong hour. Pick the time from the calendar so the branch time zone comes with it.
form.violation.appointment_time_zone_out: The time zone written at the end of this date and time is further from the world clock than any place keeps. Write the time with the offset your branch uses, between -12:00 and +14:00, such as 2026-09-22T09:00:00+03:00.
form.violation.appointment_time_zone_unr: The time zone written at the end of this date and time could not be read. Write the time with its UTC offset, such as 2026-09-22T09:00:00+03:00.
form.violation.appointment_window_backwa: The appointment ends before it starts. Choose an end time that is later than the start time.
form.violation.approval_limit_for_own_ro: You hold this role, so a limit on it would also be a limit for you. Ask another administrator who does not hold this role to set it, or choose a role you do not hold.
form.violation.approval_limit_for_yourse: You cannot set an approval limit for yourself: the person who sets a limit must not be the one who approves against it. Ask another administrator to set your limit.
form.violation.assignment_precondition: This job cannot move to that stage yet. Assign a technician to the job, or refresh the work order if it has already moved on, then try again.
form.violation.authorization_missing: Nobody entitled to decide has approved this visit yet, so the work cannot go ahead. Record that approval on the parties and authorization step, then try again.
form.violation.authorization_withdrawn: Someone entitled to decide has withdrawn their approval for this visit, so the work cannot go ahead. Record a new approval on the parties and authorization step, then try again.
form.violation.awaiting_customer_decisio: This job cannot move on while extra work on it is still waiting for the customer's answer. Record the customer's decision on each request, then try again.
form.violation.before_from: The end date cannot be earlier than the start date. Choose an end date on or after the start date.
form.violation.before_job_created: The time entered is earlier than the job itself. Enter a time after the job was opened.
form.violation.below_current_odometer: This reading is lower than the one already recorded for this vehicle. An odometer only counts upwards, so a lower reading is not stored as an ordinary reading. To record it, choose the earlier reading it corrects and give the reason for the correction.
form.violation.blank: This cannot be left empty. Fill it in, then save again.
form.violation.branch_company_mismatch: This branch does not belong to the company chosen.
form.violation.branch_needs_company: An entry that applies to one branch must also name the company that branch belongs to. Choose the company, then save again.
form.violation.closure_blocked: This work order cannot be closed yet because required steps are still outstanding. Finish the outstanding steps shown on this page, then close it again.
form.violation.closure_requires_closure_: That stage closes the work order, so it cannot be set here. Use the closing action for this work order instead.
form.violation.companion_field_required: One more entry is needed before this can be saved. Nothing entered is wrong; the entry shown beside this message has been left empty and is required here.
form.violation.completion_requires_compl: An inspection is finished with the action that completes the report, not by moving it to another stage. Use that action instead.
form.violation.completion_window_inverte: The finished-on dates are the wrong way round. The earlier date goes first and the later date second.
form.violation.content_type_not_allowed: This kind of file is not accepted for this document. Choose a file of an accepted kind, then try again.
form.violation.context_already_assigned: A price list is already assigned for this coverage at this priority. Choose a different priority, or end the assignment already in place.
form.violation.control_characters: The reason contains characters that cannot be saved. Retype it as ordinary text, then try again.
form.violation.credit_note_self_approval: You raised this credit note, so you cannot approve it. Another person who can manage credit notes must approve it.
form.violation.custom: This value is not accepted here.
form.violation.delivery_already_complete: This handover is finished and the vehicle has been released, so it cannot be changed. What is shown now is the record as it was completed.
form.violation.delivery_balance_outstand: Money is still owed on this work, so the vehicle cannot be released. Take the payment, or ask someone allowed to release it anyway to do so and say why.
form.violation.delivery_checks_outstandi: A required check on the handover list has no result yet, so the vehicle cannot be released. Complete the checks that are left, or waive one and say why, then try again.
form.violation.delivery_custody_already_: This vehicle has already been handed back on this visit, so it cannot be handed back again. What is shown now is the current record.
form.violation.delivery_parts_outstandin: Parts are still held or unaccounted for on this work, so the vehicle cannot be released. Return them or account for them first.
form.violation.delivery_quality_check_no: The quality check on this work has not passed, so the vehicle cannot be released. Have the work checked and passed first.
form.violation.delivery_receiver_already: Somebody has already been confirmed to receive this vehicle, and a handover keeps only one. What is shown now is the person on file.
form.violation.delivery_receiver_missing: Nobody has been confirmed to receive the vehicle, so it cannot be released. Confirm who is collecting it first.
form.violation.delivery_receiver_not_ent: The person named is not recorded on this visit as someone who may collect the vehicle. Record their role on the visit first, or choose someone already on it.
form.violation.delivery_signature_missin: No signature has been collected for this handover, so the vehicle cannot be released. Collect the signature first.
form.violation.delivery_stopped: This handover is marked as a problem, so nothing more can be recorded against it. Settle the problem first, or start the handover again.
form.violation.delivery_work_not_finishe: The work on the vehicle is not finished, so it cannot be released. Finish and close the work first.
form.violation.did_not_verify: We could not confirm your current password. Enter it again.
form.violation.discount_approval_already: This discount has already been approved or turned down, so it cannot be decided again. Refresh the page to see the decision that was recorded.
form.violation.discount_approval_amount_: The discount on this draft is no longer the one that was approved, so it cannot be issued. Make a new draft so the discount can be approved again.
form.violation.discount_approval_pending: This draft carries a discount that is still waiting for approval, so it cannot be issued yet. Another person has to approve the discount first.
form.violation.discount_approval_permiss: You cannot decide this discount: it needs a permission you do not hold. Leave it for an approver who holds it.
form.violation.discount_approval_rejecte: The discount on this draft was turned down, so this draft can never be issued. Make a new draft without that discount, or with a smaller one.
form.violation.discount_approval_require: This draft carries a discount that needs approval, and nobody has asked for it yet. Make a new draft with the same discount, so another person can approve it.
form.violation.discount_approval_superse: This discount request was replaced by a newer draft of the same quotation, so it can no longer be decided. Decide the request on the newer draft instead.
form.violation.discount_approver_must_di: You asked for this discount, so you cannot approve it or turn it down. Another person with a discount approval limit has to decide it. Nobody approves their own discount.
form.violation.discount_limit_currency_m: Your discount approval limit is in another currency, so it does not cover this discount. Leave it for an approver whose limit is in the same currency.
form.violation.discount_no_approval_limi: You have no discount approval limit that counts for this company, so you cannot approve this discount. A limit you set yourself, for your own account or for a role you hold, never counts. Ask another administrator to set your limit, or leave the discount for another approver.
form.violation.discount_over_approval_li: This discount is larger than your approval limit, so you cannot approve it. Leave it for an approver whose limit covers the whole discount, or turn it down so the quotation can be changed.
form.violation.discount_threshold_curren: A percentage threshold has no currency. Leave the currency empty.
An amount threshold needs its currency. Enter the three-letter currency code.
form.violation.discount_threshold_percen: A percentage threshold must be between 0 and 100.

form.violation.duplicate_identifier: This code is already in use. Enter a different code.

form.violation.duplicate_signature: A price rule with the same coverage and the same priority already exists on this version. Give this one a different priority, then save again.
form.violation.duplicate_sku: This SKU is already used in the organisation.
form.violation.empty_patch: Nothing was changed, so there is nothing to save.
form.violation.empty_update: Nothing was changed, so there is nothing to save. Change at least one detail, then try again.
form.violation.expired: Permission to upload this file has run out. Choose the file again to start a new upload.
form.violation.foreign_template: The version chosen to copy from belongs to a different checklist. Choose a version of this checklist.
form.violation.future_instant: The time entered is in the future. Enter the time the work actually happened.
form.violation.identity_disabled: This account has been switched off, so it cannot be activated. Ask an administrator to switch it back on first.
form.violation.incoherent_reference: The choices made here do not fit together, so nothing was saved. Check what you selected, then try again.
form.violation.ineligible_reference: Only a person who is set up to receive vehicles at this branch can be chosen here. Choose a name from the list offered.
form.violation.inexact_line_base: This quantity multiplied by the unit price gives an amount that cannot be held exactly. Change the quantity so the line comes out to an exact amount, then try again.
form.violation.invalid: This value was not accepted. Check it and try again.
form.violation.invalid_format: This is not written the way this field expects.
form.violation.invalid_length: What was entered here is too short or too long. Adjust its length, then try again.
form.violation.invalid_state: The vehicle cannot be moved to this state yet. A vehicle in use must first have a chassis number, or another code recorded that identifies it.
form.violation.invalid_string: This is not written the way a currency is written here. Enter the three-letter currency code, in capitals, then try again.
form.violation.invalid_transition: This cannot move from its present state to the one you chose. Choose a different state.
form.violation.invalid_type: This field did not receive a value it can use.
form.violation.invalid_value: Something entered here was not accepted. Check the entries on this form, then try again.
form.violation.mandatory_item_unresolved: Some required inspection items still have no answer. Answer them, then complete the report.
form.violation.material_approval_require: This still needs an approved amount with every fact that amount rests on, so nothing was saved. Supply what the request says is missing, have it approved, then try again.

form.violation.material_request_issued: Parts were handed out against this material, so it is settled rather than withdrawn. Settle it instead, and take back anything that was handed out by mistake.
form.violation.material_request_not_open: This material has already been settled or withdrawn, so it cannot be settled or withdrawn again. Nothing was changed.
form.violation.material_requirement_alre: This request is no longer waiting for a decision: it has already been approved, turned down or withdrawn. Nothing was changed. Refresh the page to see where it stands now.
form.violation.material_requirement_clos: This request was turned down or withdrawn, so there is nothing left to look at again. Ask for the material again if the job still needs it.
form.violation.material_requirement_comm: Material is still asked for, held or handed out against this request, so it cannot be withdrawn. Settle or withdraw the draws against it and take back what was handed out, then try again.
form.violation.material_requirement_miss: This request cannot be decided yet: the part is counted in a different unit from the one the amount is stated in, and no exact conversion between them has been recorded. Add the conversion for this part, check the request again, then decide it.

form.violation.material_requirement_reje: This request was turned down, so it cannot also be withdrawn. Nothing was changed; ask for the material again if the job still needs it.
form.violation.material_separation_of_du: The person who asked for this may not decide it. Ask another approver to decide it.
form.violation.material_unknown_referenc: Something this request names is not in this organisation: the service line, the part, the part group or the unit. The service does not say which of them.
form.violation.max_length: This is longer than the maximum allowed.
form.violation.mismatch: A receipt must be in the same currency as the charge it pays. Choose the matching currency, then try again.
form.violation.must_be_after_from: The end date must come after the start date. Choose a later end date, then run the report again.
form.violation.no_items: A version with no items cannot be published. Add at least one item to it, then publish it.
form.violation.no_opening_stage: No opening stage for jobs is set up in this workshop yet. Ask an administrator to set one up.
form.violation.no_state_change: This account is already in that state, so nothing needed to change.
form.violation.not-own-profile: You can only record time on your own work. Ask a supervisor to record time for someone else.
form.violation.not_a_closing_state: That stage does not close the work order. Choose a stage that ends the work, or move the work order the usual way.
form.violation.not_a_numeric_item: This item does not take a measurement. Record its answer in the way the item asks for.
form.violation.not_after_start: The end date must come after the start date. Choose a later end date.
form.violation.not_earlier: A correction can only refer to a reading taken at or before the time entered here. Choose an earlier reading, or check the observed time.
form.violation.not_forward_only: The date this version starts must come after the start date of the version already published. Choose a later date, then publish again.
form.violation.not_found: The record this refers to could not be found.
form.violation.not_independent: Rework cannot be signed off by the technician who carried it out. Ask a colleague to sign it off.
form.violation.not_on_reception_visit: Only someone recorded on this visit may decide about this work. Choose a person who is on the visit.
form.violation.not_owned: This record is not available to you.

form.violation.origin_required: Extra work has to say which job or inspection finding it came from, and this request names neither. Choose the job the work was found on.

form.violation.out_of_range: This value is not accepted for this entry. Check what this entry allows, then try again.

form.violation.parent_not_warehouse: Only a warehouse can contain other places.
form.violation.parent_outside_branch: The warehouse belongs to another branch.
form.violation.parent_required: Storage and quarantine places need a warehouse.
form.violation.plan_document: This plan could not be saved because one of its features is not one the platform offers, or one of its limits is outside the accepted range. Check both, then try again.
form.violation.platform_address_not_avai: This email address cannot be used for an account here. Use a different address.
form.violation.platform_administrator_ex: This organisation already has an active administrator. To add another one, say so and give the reason.
form.violation.platform_cancellation_too: A subscription cannot be ended on or before the day it began. Choose a later end date.
form.violation.platform_change_needs_dif: An upgrade or a downgrade has to name a plan different from the one in force. To stay on the same plan, record a renewal instead.
form.violation.platform_invitation_alrea: That invitation has already been accepted, so there is nothing to send again. The person can sign in with that address.
form.violation.platform_no_invitation_to: There is no unopened invitation for that address in this organisation, so there is nothing to send again. Invite the address instead.
form.violation.platform_period_starts_to: The new period would start on or before the day the current subscription began. Choose a later start date.
form.violation.platform_plan_not_availab: No active plan with that code covers the start date asked for. Choose another plan, or a start date the plan covers.
form.violation.platform_plan_version_ove: Another active version of that plan already covers part of that period. Choose a period that does not overlap it.
form.violation.platform_renewal_needs_sa: A renewal has to name the plan already in force. To move to a different plan, record an upgrade or a downgrade instead.
form.violation.platform_subscription_not: This subscription is not active, so it cannot be ended. What is shown now is the current record.
form.violation.platform_subscription_ove: Another active subscription already covers part of that period for this organisation. Choose a period that does not overlap it.
form.violation.powertrain_mismatch: This electric option does not match the engine type recorded for this vehicle. Choose an option that suits this vehicle.
form.violation.primary_already_assigned: This job already has a lead technician. End the current lead assignment first, or add this person as a helper instead.
form.violation.profile-inactive: This technician is not active at the moment, so work cannot be given to them and their time cannot be recorded. Choose an active technician, or ask an administrator to make this one active again.
form.violation.quantity: The quantity on this line is not accepted. Enter a quantity greater than zero, then try again.
form.violation.reception_already_convert: This visit has already been turned into a work order, so it cannot be converted again. Open the work order to carry on with the job.
form.violation.reception_already_finishe: This visit has already been closed, so it cannot be closed or refused again. What is shown now is the current record.
form.violation.reception_closed_to_evide: This visit has already been closed, so nothing further can be added to its record. Open a new visit if the vehicle has come back.
form.violation.reception_not_authorised: This visit has not been approved yet, so it cannot be turned into a work order. Record the customer approval on the parties and authorisation step, approve the visit, then convert it.
form.violation.reception_party_not_autho: The person named is not recorded as someone who may approve work on this visit in that capacity. Record the right role for them on the parties and authorisation step, or choose someone whose recorded role allows it.
form.violation.refused: This blocker entry was not accepted. A note in words is required, and a resolution has to answer a blocker that is still open on this job. Check what was written, then try again.
form.violation.requester_or_authorizatio: This visit still needs the person who is asking for the work, and their approval, before it can be approved. Both are recorded on the parties and authorization step.
form.violation.required_for_numeric: An item that is measured needs a unit of measure. Enter the unit, then save again.
form.violation.role_archived: This role has been retired and can no longer be given to anyone. Choose a role that is still in use.
form.violation.self_review: An inspection cannot be reviewed by the person who carried it out. Ask a colleague to review it.
form.violation.session-already-open: A work session is already running. Stop the session that is running before starting another.
form.violation.size_out_of_range: This file is too large or too small for this document. Choose a file within the accepted size.
form.violation.state_and_group_exclusive: Choose either a single stage or a group of stages, not both. Clear one of them and search again.
form.violation.state_not_approvable: This visit has moved past the point where it can be approved. What is shown now is the current record.
form.violation.status_and_group_exclusiv: Choose either a single status or a group of statuses, not both. Clear one of them and search again.
form.violation.stock_adjustment_already_: This stock correction has already been approved or turned down, so it cannot be decided again. Refresh the page to see the decision that was recorded.
form.violation.stock_adjustment_separati: You asked for this stock correction, so someone else has to decide it. Ask a supervisor to review it.
form.violation.stock_count_closed: This stock count is finished or cancelled, so it can no longer be changed. Open a new count if another one is needed.
form.violation.stock_damage_other_branch: Damage has to stay inside one branch, and the two places you chose are in different branches. Choose a damaged-stock place in the same branch.
form.violation.stock_damage_releases_res: Recording this much as damaged would free more than that from what is being held for jobs, because each hold is freed whole. Release the affected holds yourself first, then record the damage.
form.violation.stock_issue_exceeds_reser: That is more than is being held for this job. Hold more first, or hand out only the amount that is being held.
form.violation.stock_item_archived: This part has been retired, so stock can no longer be moved for it. Choose the part that replaced it.
form.violation.stock_item_not_tracked: Stock is not counted for this part, so there is no balance to move. Choose a part whose stock is counted, or ask for stock counting to be turned on for it.
form.violation.stock_location_not_active: This storage place is closed, so stock cannot be moved in or out of it. Choose another place, or ask your company administrator to reopen it.
form.violation.stock_location_other_bran: This storage place belongs to another branch. Choose a place in the branch you are working in.
form.violation.stock_location_quarantine: This storage place holds damaged stock, which cannot be reserved, handed out or counted in here. Choose another place; damaged stock leaves through an approved correction.
form.violation.stock_location_transit: This storage place holds deliveries that are still on their way, so that stock is not available here yet. Receive or cancel the delivery first, or choose another place.
form.violation.stock_opening_batch_empty: An opening count with no counted lines cannot be approved. Add at least one counted line first.
form.violation.stock_opening_batch_froze: This opening count has been approved and is now fixed, so its lines cannot be changed. Correct the balance with a stock correction instead.
form.violation.stock_receipt_cost_permis: You do not have permission to record or view purchase costs. Remove the cost or contact your company administrator.
form.violation.stock_receipt_not_draft: This goods receipt has already been entered into stock, or it was cancelled, so it cannot be entered again. Nothing was changed. Refresh the page to see where it stands.
form.violation.stock_return_exceeds_issu: That is more than was handed out on this job, counting what has already come back. Lower the amount and try again.
form.violation.stock_work_order_closed: This job is finished or cancelled, so nothing more can be added to it. Reopen it, or record this against the job it really belongs to.
form.violation.stock_work_order_other_br: This job belongs to a different branch from the storage place you chose. Choose a storage place in the job's own branch.
form.violation.tax_needs_company: A tax class can only be set on a price rule that names a company. Choose the company, or leave the tax class empty.
form.violation.terminal_state: A new job cannot start in a stage that ends the work. Choose a stage the work starts in, then save again.
form.violation.too_big: This is longer or larger than allowed.
form.violation.too_long: What was entered here is longer than allowed. Shorten it, then try again.
form.violation.too_small: This is shorter or smaller than allowed.
form.violation.transfer_not_cancellable: This delivery can no longer be cancelled: some of it has already arrived, or it was cancelled before. Settle what is still on its way instead.
form.violation.transfer_not_receivable: This delivery can no longer be received: it has already arrived in full, or it was cancelled. Nothing was changed. Refresh the page to see where it stands.
form.violation.transfer_nothing_in_trans: There is nothing still on its way on this delivery to settle: it has already arrived in full, or it was cancelled.
form.violation.transfer_receipt_exceeds_: That is more than is still on its way, so nothing was recorded. Record only what actually arrived.
form.violation.transfer_separation_of_du: You asked for this write-off, so someone else has to decide it. Ask a supervisor to review it.
form.violation.transfer_settlement_excee: That is more than is still on its way, counting anything already waiting to be written off. Lower the amount and try again.
form.violation.transfer_write_off_not_pe: Only a write-off that is still waiting for a decision can be decided. This one has already been decided, or it is a return to the sending branch rather than a write-off.
form.violation.type_mismatch: This value does not match the kind of setting chosen — for example a number where text was entered. Enter a value of that kind, then save again.
form.violation.unit_mismatch: The unit does not match the one this item is measured in.
form.violation.unknown_category: This category does not exist in the organisation.
form.violation.unknown_company: The company chosen is not available here. Choose a company from the list offered.
form.violation.unknown_currency: This currency is not one the workshop uses.
form.violation.unknown_location: This location does not exist in the branch.
form.violation.unknown_reason: This is not one of the reasons a correction can be recorded under.
form.violation.unknown_reference: This choice does not match any existing record.
form.violation.unknown_state: That job stage is not one this workshop uses. Choose a stage from the list, then save again.
form.violation.unknown_unit: This unit is not visible to the organisation.
form.violation.unsupported_currency: This currency is not one the platform supports. Choose one of the currencies offered.
form.violation.warehouse_has_no_parent: A warehouse cannot be inside another location.
form.violation.window-overlaps: The corrected times overlap a session that is already recorded. Choose times that do not overlap.
form.violation.window_too_wide: The period you chose is too long to search. Choose a shorter period, then try again.
form.violation.work_order_closed_to_extr: This work order is not at a stage that accepts extra work. Extra work has to be raised and agreed before the job goes for its final checks.
form.violation.work_order_closed_to_job_: This work order is closed, so its tasks can no longer be changed. What is shown now is the record as it was left.
form.violation.work_order_closed_to_jobs: This work order is not at a stage that accepts new tasks. Move it back to a working stage first, or put the task on a new work order.
form.violation.work_order_closed_to_line: This work order is closed, so no more work or parts can be added to it. Open a new work order for anything else the vehicle needs.
form.violation.work_order_extra_work_alr: A customer decision has already been recorded for this extra work, and only one is kept. What is shown now is the decision on file.
This extra work has already been recorded that way, so nothing was changed. What is shown now is the current record.
form.violation.work_order_extra_work_not: The customer has not agreed to this extra work yet, so it cannot be marked as done or dropped. Record their decision first.
form.violation.work_order_quotation_expi: This quotation has passed the date it was valid until, so a decision cannot rest on it. Issue a fresh quotation and have the customer agree to that one.
form.violation.work_order_quotation_not_: The customer has not agreed to this quotation, so it cannot release extra work. Record their agreement on the quotation first.
This quotation has not been sent to the customer yet, so a decision cannot rest on it. Send it first, then record the decision against it.
form.violation.work_order_rework_needs_c: Repeat work can only be raised against a work order that has been finished and closed. Finish and close this one first.
form.violation.work_order_rework_on_canc: This work order was cancelled, so there is no finished work to put right. Open a new work order for the job.
form.violation.work_order_stock_still_he: Parts are still reserved or issued to this work order, so it cannot be closed. Return what was not used and release the reservations, then close it.
form.violation.work_order_visit_not_read: The reception visit behind this work order no longer allows one to be opened. Check the visit and its approval, then try again.

inventory.adjustments.create.done: Adjustment requested. Nothing changes in stock until another person approves it.

inventory.adjustments.create.heading: Request an adjustment

inventory.adjustments.decide.approved: Adjustment approved; the stock has changed.
inventory.adjustments.decide.approvedDon: Adjustment approved. The stock movement is posted.

inventory.adjustments.decide.heading: Decide the adjustment for

inventory.adjustments.decide.rejected: Adjustment rejected; the stock is unchanged.
inventory.adjustments.decide.rejectedDon: Adjustment rejected. The stock is unchanged.

inventory.counterSales.buyer.label: Chosen buyer
inventory.counterSales.buyer.more: Only the first matches are shown. Narrow the search.

inventory.counterSales.draft.heading: The sale so far

inventory.counterSales.drafts.loading: Reading the sales that were started here…

inventory.counterSales.issue.needsIssue: You do not have permission to issue a sale. Somebody who has may issue this one.
inventory.counterSales.issue.replayed: This sale had already been issued.
inventory.counterSales.line.heading: What is being sold

inventory.counterSales.sale.noAmounts: You do not have permission to see amounts.

inventory.counts.cancel.heading: Cancel this count

inventory.counts.description: Count a location and turn the differences into adjustments for approval.
inventory.counts.detail.caption: Items of this count with what was expected, what moved and what was counted
inventory.counts.detail.gone: This count could not be found.
inventory.counts.detail.heading: Count of

inventory.counts.detail.noLines: The location held nothing when this count started.

inventory.counts.reconcile.explain: Reconciling closes the count and turns each difference into an adjustment waiting for approval. No stock changes until each one is approved.
